# OIYO Tools (tools.oiyo.net)

> Browser-based file utilities in six languages, plus South Korean labor and everyday calculators. Tool inputs are processed locally; the site uses Google Analytics and AdSense.

## About
OIYO Tools provides client-side deterministic computation for statutory labor benefits, energy tariffs, military service, and civil life calculations in South Korea. Statutory rates as of 2026-01-01 (source of truth: api.oiyo.net `src/modules/kr-rates-2026.mjs`).

## File utilities (ko, en, ja, zh, fr, es)
Replace `/en/` with any listed locale to open the same utility in that language.
- https://tools.oiyo.net/en/image-converter/: Convert HEIC, WebP, PNG and JPG; compress and download locally.
- https://tools.oiyo.net/en/pdf-merge-split/: Merge PDFs or extract page ranges in the browser.
- https://tools.oiyo.net/en/qr-code-generator/: Generate static text, URL, email and Wi-Fi QR codes locally.

## South Korean calculators (11 tools)
- `/ko/unemployment-benefits-calculator/`: Korean Employment Insurance Jobseeker Allowance (실업급여) simulation (2026 separations: daily floor 66,048 KRW, ceiling 68,100 KRW, 120-270 days based on age and insured period).
- `/ko/parental-leave-calculator/`: Parental leave benefit after the 2025 reform (no deferred 25%; 6+6 caps 2.5M-4.5M KRW).
- `/ko/overtime-pay-calculator/`: Overtime, Night, and Holiday Premium Pay Calculator (근로기준법 56조: 연장 1.5배, 야간 0.5배 가산, 휴일 1.5배/2.0배).
- `/ko/health-insurance-calculator/`: Regional NHI premium, 2026 (7.19%, 211.5 KRW per property point, 100M KRW property deduction).
- `/ko/temporary-two-house-tax-calculator/`: Temporary Two-House Tax-Exempt Disposal Deadline Simulator (1-2-3 rule).
- `/ko/car-bond-refund-calculator/`: Regional Mandatory Car Bond Purchase & Discount Sale Calculator (2026 regional table).
- `/ko/gas-bill-calculator/`: Residential City Gas Bill Calculator (KOGAS 발열량 단가, 주택용 난방·취사 단가, 기본료 및 부가세).
- `/ko/military-service-calculator/`: Military Service Duration and Promotion Calculator (육군·해병대 18개월, 해군 20개월, 공군·사회복무 21개월, 계급별 진급일 및 잔여일수).
- `/ko/waste-sorter/`: Domestic Waste Sorting Helper (생활폐기물 종량제·음식물·재활용·특수규격봉투 16대 품목 판정).
- `/ko/wind-chill-calculator/`: Wind Chill and Heat Index Calculator (KMA 공식 JAG/TI 체감온도 모델).
- `/ko/business-day-checker/`: Korean Statutory Business Day & Holiday Checker (관공서의 공휴일에 관한 규정 및 대체공휴일 판정).

## API
For programmatic access, see our B2A Gateway at `https://api.oiyo.net`.
OpenAPI Specification: `https://api.oiyo.net/openapi.json`.
